case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer and for the transparent overview of your cost drivers. We value the cooperation and want to renew the agreement on a sound basis. Our data shows a different picture:

Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

Against this background we have put together two structured options, built to be easy to take to your pricing committee:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 415.73; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 412.98; payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Option A gives you a longer payment term on our side, while Option B keeps payment at the current pace. Both offer a longer contract term and binding volumes. If your approval needs further documentation from us, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. While we note your historical purchase data, our current pricing must account for the significant material cost increases we outlined previously. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We appreciate your proposal for a 36-month contract term, which provides the stability needed to adjust our offer.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €430.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Building on your Option B, we can offer EUR 428.85 per unit for a volume of 4,580 units per year with a 30-day payment term over 36 months, corresponding to an alternative package of a price of €428.85 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your reply and for taking our price history into account. We understand that your management's position limits what you can do on price, and we appreciate your openness on terms, including the longer contract.

With that in mind, we have prepared two options built around payment and contract length:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 417.55; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 414.78; payment 30 days net; contract term 36 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Option A answers your interest in faster payment, while both options give you the stability of a longer contract. Both are laid out so they can go straight to your pricing committee, and we are glad to provide any further information it needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.body:

We acknowledge your updated proposal and appreciate your flexibility regarding the contract duration. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €430.31 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.
